{
  "claims": [
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:57977",
      "quote": "C1 decode step (torch profiler, 61 steps): GPU busy 7.64 → 6.85 ms (−10 %)",
      "claim": "The PR author reports a GPU time reduction after removing MXFP8 quantization launches on 4×B200 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "TP4 + EP4, MegaMoE + sequence parallelism, FlashInfer sparse MLA, FP8 KV; C1 decode.",
      "reported_result": "Quantize launches fell from 130 to 90. These are author measurements, not independently checked results.",
      "transfer_inference": "Launch removal is a plausible low-concurrency opportunity, but this result does not identify expert GEMM selection or padding as the bottleneck.",
      "limitations": "The PR is open. Effects on other DeepSeek checkpoints and hardware are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:57977",
      "quote": "C1 ×3 TPOT | 6.58 / 6.58 / 6.58 ms | 6.50 / 6.50 / 6.50 ms",
      "claim": "The same author reports only a 1.2% C1 decode TPOT improvement despite the larger GPU busy-time reduction.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Same 4×B200 serving setup; random 4096/256 benchmark.",
      "reported_result": "C1 TPOT was 6.58 ms baseline and 6.50 ms with the PR in each of three runs.",
      "transfer_inference": "A faster low-M kernel or fewer launches may have little C1 user-visible benefit if the reported host-loop bound also applies.",
      "limitations": "No independently checked host-loop trace is supplied; the bound is the PR author's explanation."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:54520",
      "quote": "M/rank | FlashInfer baseline (tok/s) | DeepGEMM fused (tok/s)",
      "claim": "The PR author compared existing MoE backends across small per-rank loads; this is relevant selection evidence, but from GB300 and GLM-5.2 rather than B200 DeepSeek.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "8×GB300, DP8/EP8, TP1; steady decode with 128 input and 256 output tokens.",
      "reported_result": "At M/rank=1, author-reported throughput was 532 versus 560 tok/s (+5.12%).",
      "transfer_inference": "Benchmark competing existing backends at the actual per-expert load before adding another low-M path.",
      "limitations": "PR is closed without a supplied merge; measurements are author reported. B200 DeepSeek decode TPOT effect is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:55015",
      "quote": "Use new FlashInfer CuteDSL MoE api which support mxfp8 x mxfp4 dtypes and improves low latency decode performance",
      "claim": "A low-latency CuteDSL MoE API is already an integration target, limiting novelty of a generic low-M kernel proposal.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Open vLLM PR; model and hardware for the performance claim are unspecified.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports test PASS but provides no decode TPOT or effect size.",
      "transfer_inference": "Include this path in a low-M baseline comparison if its dtype and layout contracts fit the target model.",
      "limitations": "The stated performance improvement is a PR author claim; B200 DeepSeek applicability is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2410.12247",
      "quote": "switching from GroupedGemm to DenseGemm at a certain token number is also an important feature",
      "claim": "Load-dependent grouped-versus-dense GEMM selection is established prior work.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "EPS-MoE paper conclusion; experiments include DeepSeekV2, but the supplied excerpt gives no B200 setup.",
      "reported_result": "No relevant threshold, decode TPOT effect size, or hardware result is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "Adaptation 1: test a graph-compatible selection between existing grouped and dense expert GEMMs at measured low per-expert M. Predeclare M buckets, compare C1/C4 decode TPOT and correctness against current selection, and retain it only where the gain repeats.",
      "limitations": "The excerpt establishes prior art, not an implemented vLLM mechanism or a measured B200 bottleneck."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2512.14080",
      "quote": "tile-aware token rounding that yields additional speedup without quality loss",
      "claim": "Tile-aware rounding is prior work relevant to grouped-GEMM padding.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "SonicMoE conclusion describes training-oriented work.",
      "reported_result": "The supplied excerpt gives no B200 DeepSeek decode TPOT result or applicable padding ratio.",
      "transfer_inference": "Padding policy merits measurement only after recording routed tokens, padded rows, and time by expert and M bucket.",
      "limitations": "Training results do not establish a decode benefit; precision and expert-parallel applicability are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "code:vllm-project/vllm:61aa7068b0f98677fa2166ff823d88330e70d47e:vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/prepare_megamoe.py",
      "quote": "ids = tl.where(token_is_padding, -1, ids)",
      "claim": "The supplied code independently confirms an existing padding-mask mechanism in NVFP4 MegaMoE input staging; it also zeroes weights for padded tokens.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Pinned vLLM source file; NVFP4 staging path.",
      "reported_result": "Implementation evidence for masking, with no benchmark result.",
      "transfer_inference": "Adaptation 2: if profiling finds material padded expert work, test a graph-safe staging or padding change against this existing mechanism, checking padded-token semantics, CUDA Graph replay, and C1/C4 decode TPOT.",
      "limitations": "The excerpt does not show that the target B200 DeepSeek path uses this NVFP4 code or spends material time on padding."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:54520",
      "quote": "Keep symmetric-buffer allocation/rendezvous outside forward and CUDA Graph capture.",
      "claim": "The PR author identifies a concrete CUDA Graph integration constraint for MegaMoE staging.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "NVFP4 DeepGEMM MegaMoE integration on GB300/GLM-5.2.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports CUDA Graph replay tests, but their outputs are not supplied here.",
      "transfer_inference": "Any dynamic low-M selection or padding change should use capture-stable buffers and be checked under replay.",
      "limitations": "This is an author design claim; the exact B200 DeepSeek graph mode and constraints are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:60468",
      "quote": "The DeepGEMM warmup covers `fp8_gemm_nt` and the grouped MoE GEMM.",
      "claim": "Existing DeepGEMM warmup and the merged MegaMoE warmup limit novelty of a generic precompile proposal.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Merged PR; its reported validation used B300 DeepSeek-V4-Flash.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports MegaMoE serving-time compiles falling to zero, while cold startup grew by 247–299 s on fully empty caches.",
      "transfer_inference": "A new kernel variant must account for warmup coverage and startup cost; first-request TTFT gains should be kept separate from steady decode TPOT.",
      "limitations": "The supplied validation is author reported and on B300; B200 effect is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:46238",
      "quote": "TMA (Tensor Memory Accelerator) alignment faults when each expert only processes a small number of tokens",
      "claim": "The PR author reports an unsafe SM100 autotuning case for `trtllm_bf16_moe` at small M.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "B200/SM100 FlashInfer warmup autotune, BF16 MoE; example M=1.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports an illegal-address startup crash and proposes disabling autotune for that kernel during warmup. Full CUDA tests were not run in the supplied account.",
      "transfer_inference": "Do not sweep arbitrary low-M configurations through this warmup path without a guard or verified safe candidate set.",
      "limitations": "The PR is open; the failure and fix are author claims, and applicability to other kernels is unknown."
    }
  ],
  "unanswered": [
    "What are the actual per-expert M distribution, padded-row ratio, kernel times, and launch costs for the target B200 DeepSeek decode workload?",
    "Which DeepSeek checkpoint, precision, expert backend, graph mode, and concurrency range are the target? Their effect on kernel eligibility is unknown.",
    "Do existing low-M backend choices beat the current path on repeated C1/C4 decode TPOT after graph capture, without changing outputs?",
    "Is padding a material measured cost in that path, and can a change improve TPOT while preserving padding semantics and CUDA Graph replay?"
  ]
}
